case_scope: United States municipal infrastructure, fiscal capacity, and public-service wealth

place_public_finance_gate.note: Official EPA water/wastewater needs carry the direct infrastructure burden; NLC and ASCE materials are contextual stress/fiscal-capacity evidence rather than operative authority.

municipal_fiscal_capacity.note: City fiscal capacity must be proved with audited budgets, reserves, debt service, revenue authority, and grant-match ability, not association summaries alone. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD subnational-finance evidence is now bound to the municipal fiscal-capacity burden.

infrastructure_backlog.note: Water, wastewater, stormwater, roads, and public assets carry large official need estimates and local execution burdens.

water_wastewater_need_pressure.note: EPA drinking-water and clean-watershed needs are direct official evidence that ratepayers/localities face large capital and compliance pressure.

capital_grant_absorption_capacity.note: Grant dollars convert only if local governments have match, engineering, procurement, workforce, and administrative capacity.

user_fee_special_assessment_regressivity.note: User fees, special assessments, water/sewer rate design, and debt service incidence remain unresolved household pass-through channels.

proof_debt: rate and fee incidence by income and tenure
debt service, reserves, and credit access

gate_15_place_public_finance.why: Gate 15 remains watch: public infrastructure is not durable household/service wealth unless fiscal capacity, official needs, local delivery, and ratepayer incidence are proven together.

evidence_debt_register.question: local asset-condition inventories
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Require asset-condition and useful-life inventories for streets, bridges, schools, parks, water, wastewater, and stormwater before counting public assets as wealth.

evidence_debt_register.question: rate and fee incidence by income and tenure
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Trace water, sewer, stormwater, transportation, and special-assessment costs to renters, homeowners, and small businesses.

evidence_debt_register.question: grant match and technical capacity
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Document match requirements, staff capacity, engineering readiness, environmental review, and procurement timing for federal/state infrastructure grants.

evidence_debt_register.question: workforce/procurement delivery capacity
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether labor, contractors, procurement rules, and supply chains allow need estimates to become delivered public assets.

evidence_debt_register.question: small-system water and wastewater capacity
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Separate large-city and small-system needs because technical capacity and rate-base limits produce different household incidence.

evidence_debt_register.question: debt service, reserves, and credit access
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Score reserves, debt service, bond-market access, revenue volatility, and local tax authority as part of public-asset durability.

validation_notes: rev0335 removed stale place_public_finance_gate_seed calibration label; active scoring now requires source-backed service-floor, fiscal-capacity, and threshold-moment evidence.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S243 to `municipal_fiscal_capacity` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
